overall_notes: Alexandria loki-grafana-stack guide was updated during Phase 3 with Grafana password init gotcha and env() deprecation warning. No new Alexandria updates needed from Phase 4 — Blackbox and GitHub Pages monitoring patterns are covered by prometheus-grafana-docker-compose guide. Parallel execution worked flawlessly. Key insight: devops-engineer agent is capable of running the entire Helldiver pipeline (all 7 agent roles) in a single invocation when given a well-structured task — the specialized sub-agents are useful for complex projects but not strictly required for simpler targets. Docker-in-Docker limitation means prometheus --check-config validation runs via the live EC2 reload endpoint rather than locally.
